bias.zh: 转弱 · 失守 30 日均线

read.en: Lumentum fell 9.3% on Oct 14 to $896.33 and is down 19% in five sessions from the Oct 9 record. It is below its 5-day ($1,006.3), 10-day ($1,049.9) and 30-day ($964.0) averages and above the 100-day ($876.6) and 200-day ($772.7). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 13 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($1,135.4), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月14日下跌 9.3%，收于 $896.33，自 10月9日纪录高点起五个交易日下跌 19%。股价位于 5 日（$1,006.3）、10 日（$1,049.9）和 30 日均线（$964.0）下方，并在 100 日（$876.6）和 200 日均线（$772.7）上方。MACD 于 10月13日下穿信号线，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$1,135.4），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The 30-day average support ($958–964) broke on the close and is now first resistance, then $1,007 (September shelf, 5-day average) and $1,050 (10-day). The day's low of $893.88 approached the $877–881 zone (Sep 28 low and 100-day average), the next support, with $832 (Sep 15 low) and $819 (Sep 3 low) below. A close below $876 would open $832.
read.zh: 30 日均线支撑（$958–964）收盘失守，现转为第一阻力，其次 $1,007（9月平台、5 日均线）和 $1,050（10 日均线）。当日低点 $893.88 接近下一支撑 $877–881 区域（9月28日低点及 100 日均线），其下为 $832（9月15日低点）和 $819（9月3日低点）。若收盘跌破 $876，下一目标看 $832。
